title: How a Tiny Email List Built a 7-Figure Business (Real Growth Hacks)
promo_conflict: Guest promotes Growth in Reverse; sponsor ad segment.

idea.name: Local city events newsletter grown via Reddit
idea.one_liner: Weekly newsletter of unique local events, grown by building karma in city subreddits and answering 'things to do' questions fully before linking the newsletter

key_quotes.quote: And she was able to kind of grow her initial following up to over I think 5,000 subscribers by some strategic Reddit commenting, yes.
But I think this is one, if you are having a local newsletters one where you could kind of rinse and repeat in any number of local sub-bedits to kind of borrow from the same playbook.

claims.quote: And so after doing this for months and months, one post she ended up replying to, she got like 1500 subscribers from that one comment.

acquisition_channels.details: value-first answers in city subreddits with newsletter link

ideas.other_uk_rules: PECR/UK GDPR consent for email list; ASA rules for marked sponsored content

idea.name: Podcast guesting academy (shoulder-topic pitching)
idea.one_liner: High-ticket program teaching experts to land podcast guest spots on adjacent 'shoulder' topic shows, with criteria and pitch templates, marketed by the founder guesting himself

key_quotes.quote: Like if you're a relationship coach, you shouldn't be pitching relationship coaches.

claims.quote: And so he's now bringing in around $285 per subscriber per year, which is like bonkers if you think about it.

idea.name: Legal setup education for online entrepreneurs

key_quotes.quote: It says Sam is an attorney who helps online entrepreneurs protect, you know, and legally set up their business in the right way.

claims.quote: This webinar that we were specifically talking about, she got 11,000 people to sign up for it.

claims.claim: Over 50% of attendees bought a $2,000+ product
claims.quote: And I think over 50% of the people, of those people who showed up bought the product. And it's like a $2,000 plus product.
